issues.description: Default turn detection mode change is a breaking behavioral change for existing users
issues.detail: Switching the default from EXTERNAL to FIXED silently changes endpointing behavior for any user who previously relied on the default. Existing pipelines depending on Pipecat external endpointing semantics will see different turn finalization. This deserves a clear breaking-change note in the changelog (currently only under 'fixed') and migration guidance.

issues.description: Switch from UserStoppedSpeakingFrame to VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame may silently drop finalization
issues.detail: Previously, any UserStoppedSpeakingFrame triggered finalize(). Now only VAD-emitted variants will. If a pipeline produces UserStoppedSpeakingFrame from a non-VAD source (manual control, push-to-talk, custom processor), finalization will no longer occur in FIXED mode. Consider handling both frame types or documenting the requirement that VAD must emit the specific frame.

issues.description: speech_segment_config is overwritten unconditionally, ignoring user-provided config
issues.detail: In _prepare_config, after copying fields from params, the code unconditionally assigns config.speech_segment_config = SpeechSegmentConfig(emit_sentences=...). If a preset or earlier code path set other fields on speech_segment_config, they are clobbered. Consider mutating an existing config or merging, and only assign when split_sentences was explicitly provided.

issues.description: EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED referenced but not shown to exist in this SDK version
issues.detail: _enable_vad now checks against EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED in addition to EXTERNAL. The diff doesn't add FIXED to any imported enum, so this depends on the 0.0.99 speechmatics SDK exposing it. If the installed SDK is older, this raises AttributeError at construction. Pin or validate the minimum speechmatics package version in pyproject/requirements.

issues.description: split_sentences feature change is documented in fixed changelog, but also as added — duplication
issues.detail: 3328.added.md documents split_sentences and 3328.fixed.md does not — but the PR description's 'What's Changed' lists only the fixes, not the new split_sentences param. The PR title/description should mention the new parameter so reviewers and release notes consumers can find it.

issues.description: Commented-out start_processing_metrics call moved but not removed
issues.detail: The line `# await self.start_processing_metrics()` was relocated within _handle_start_of_turn. If metrics are intentionally disabled, remove the dead comment; if they should run, uncomment. Leaving commented code creates ambiguity about intent.

review.summary: This PR updates SpeechmaticsSTTService for SDK 0.0.99, changing the default turn detection mode to FIXED, adding a split_sentences parameter, and switching finalization to listen for VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame. The main concerns are (1) the default-mode change is a behavioral break that needs clearer migration messaging, (2) the frame-type switch may silently lose finalization for non-VAD pipelines, and (3) speech_segment_config is unconditionally overwritten, which can clobber preset values. Also worth verifying the EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED enum exists in the pinned speechmatics SDK version. Minor cleanup nits around dead commented code and changelog clarity.
